caption: The drawing shows a wooden chair with a woven seat, depicted in a naturalistic style. The chair has a ladder-back design with three horizontal wooden slats forming the backrest and two vertical posts as the sides, which extend above the top slat. The chair has two armrests attached to the vertical posts and connecting to the front legs, which are also wooden and cylindrical. The seat is made of a woven material in a tan color, arranged in a geometric pattern. There are two horizontal supports connecting the front legs and running parallel to the seat, as well as horizontal stretchers joining the legs on the sides and across the bottom. The wood of the chair is illustrated in varying shades of brown with visible grain. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, monochrome line drawing of the chair shown from the side, including dimension lines. The main drawing is centered within a faint rectangular border, and the artist’s signature appears on the bottom right inside the border. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Chair
